channel.title: Sukrara for Mac
channel.description: Updates of Sukrara for Mac (the GitHub and Homebrew version).

item.title: Sukrara 0.14.3
item.description:
• Low is below 70, and the low alerts ring where the card says Low (both apps; the owner: "Low is below 70 (70 is in the okay range), so from 69 downwards. And very low from 55 or lower"): every limit is the first value of the range it names, so at the defaults very low is up to 55, low 56–69, in range 70–179, high 180–249 and very high from 250, on the card (colours, range word, time in range, report) and in the alerts alike. The low limits' defaults are now 55 and 69 (were 54 and 70), and the low and very low alerts ring at their threshold, not only below it (a low alert at 69 rings at 69). Time in range counts 70 in range again, like LibreView; 180 stays high.
  • Each range limit and alert threshold says which values it covers (both apps): Low: 56–69 mg/dL, In range: 70–179 mg/dL, Very high: 250–299 under the number, in your unit, and it follows the number while you type.
  • Add treatment (Android) looks like the earlier app again (#181): each field's label carries its chart marker and stays on the outline, so the dialog no longer jumps in height when you move between fields; the time is a chip next to the title; over the lock screen Unlock sits where Open Sukrara does, without the extra countdown line, and the dialog now closes unsaved after 10 s by default (was 20 s; Settings › Lock screen › Time to save).
  • App icons in Settings are back (Android, #181): the rows for LibreView, Tidepool, Nightscout, the xDrip+ server, Health Connect, Juggluco and every app glucose is sent to show that app's own icon again, as in the earlier app, and Garmin Connect is listed under the xDrip+ server again.
  • Android › Alert reliability (dark theme): with every check on, the top banner is one card again; it showed a grey rectangle inside a darker card (#181).
  • Android › Settings search works like the earlier app's again (#181): a full-screen search with each result's section icon and where it is (page and group), ranked like Android's own search (groups and other words find rows too), one result per page, and a result opens its page through the menus (Back walks up) at its row, which flashes; Alert reliability's checklist, Share with apps' rows and the night alerts' pages are searchable. Opening Night alerts from it crashed the app (and stopped monitoring) on 0.13–0.14.1 release builds while the night alerts or a quiet side applied: their lines' strings were found by name and had been shrunk away. They are found by the ids written in code now, so no build can lose them.

item.title: Sukrara 0.14.2
item.description:
• Android alerts are posted again (release builds): resource shrinking removed the alert and mute texts the app looks up by name, so a real alert's notification couldn't be built and no alert showed (the alert logic itself fired). Every string is kept now, and the release check fails if one is missing from the APK.
  • An alert that can't be shown still rings (Android and Mac): if an alert's notification can't be built or posted, Sukrara shows it plain on the same channel (its sound, vibration and Do Not Disturb behaviour: the kind, the value with its unit and arrow, Open Sukrara), or else a Monitoring problems notice, and tries the full alert again. Settings › Alert reliability (Android) and the menu bar panel (Mac) say An alert couldn't be shown, with Copy report. The failure also reaches logcat now, not only the diagnostic log.
  • A value at a limit is in the range beyond it (#181): at exactly 180 mg/dL (the high limit) the value is high, at 70 low, at 54 very low and at 250 very high, on both apps: the value's and the line's colour, the range word, the status bar, the menu bar, the notification, time in range and the report's ranges (High 180–249). Time in range now counts readings at 70 and 180 outside the range. Alerts are unchanged.
  • The Mac disk image has its own icons (#181): the opened volume is a Sukrara drive and the .dmg file a disk image page with that drive, no longer the app's icon.

item.title: Sukrara 0.14.0
item.description:
• The Android GitHub version updates itself (#188): once a day it looks for a new version and says so in a quiet notification (Update, Release notes), downloads it, checks it is the release's file signed with Sukrara's key, and installs it, never while an alert is showing or a very low is on; monitoring comes back by itself right after. Android asks once to allow installs from Sukrara. Install updates automatically (Settings › About › Updates, off) installs without a tap where Android allows it. The Google Play version keeps updating through Play. Updating to this version is still by hand; from then on Sukrara does it.
  • The Mac updates itself (GitHub and Homebrew version, #91): once a day it looks for a new version, signed by Sukrara and checked before it installs, and offers it in the menu bar panel; Install and Relaunch is one click. Settings › General › About has Check for Updates…, automatic checks (on) and automatic install (off). The App Store version keeps updating through the store. Updating to this version is still by hand (the dmg or brew upgrade); from then on Sukrara does it.
  • Do Not Disturb and Focus are respected by default (#184): the alert checklist says plainly whether Sukrara alerts in Do Not Disturb (Android) or during a Focus (Mac), with Let Sukrara through / Don't let Sukrara through (Android: Do Not Disturb access the first time, then the alarm channels' override; Mac: Time Sensitive), and home shows a neutral line while a mode keeps alerts quiet. Updating from 0.13.0: the alarm channels keep the override they have; the Mac's alerts stop being Time Sensitive until you let Sukrara through.
  • Sound while the phone is unlocked (Android, #183) is answered from a test alert: Test the sound, then I heard it / It only vibrated. The earlier answer is asked again.
  • Widgets and the card look like the earlier app again (#181): Android's widgets are drawn at the size the launcher really gives them and are never stretched or squashed, on the home screen and in the widget picker, in the wallpaper's colours. On Android and the Mac the rings show their number without "%", a fresh value has no "now", and the value has as many slots beside it as fit (up to four).
  • Android look (#181): the phone's own colours across the app, the dark theme included, the phone's round font in titles, and Material 3 Expressive motion.
  • Settings (Android, #181): a search result opens its page at the row it found and highlights it; the alert reliability checklist, the status lines and the dialogs use Android's own settings components; Sharing's rows have their icons; TalkBack says again what a tap on an action row does (copy, import, fix).
  • Sharing (#181): a follower whose invite the wearer never answers no longer waits forever: when the invite expires, Sukrara says Invite expired with Join with a new link (Android and Mac). The Mac's Find phones nearby works again after a follow ended.
  • Fixes (#181): Active now names the right reason when a Mute and carbs quiet the same alerts (Android and Mac); Add treatment opened from home no longer offers Open Sukrara; in Spanish the app says "hidratos" everywhere and "Glucosa baja / alta" for the alert groups.
  • Not a medical device: setup's Welcome and About in Settings say so, on Android and the Mac; the Mac's About also links the privacy policy.
